pharma.title: CDSCO to launch first phase of end-to-end digital drug regulatory platform within 18 months
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) plans to launch the first phase of an end-to-end digital drug regulatory platform within 18 months to streamline regulatory governance.

pharma.title: Intas gets CDSCO nod for breast cancer drug Trastuzumab Emtansine
pharma.summary: Intas Pharmaceuticals has received regulatory approval from the CDSCO for Trastuzumab Emtansine, targeted at breast cancer treatment.

pharma.title: CDSCO proposes to ban 'Same Brand, Different Drug' practice
pharma.summary: The CDSCO has proposed prohibiting the practice of using the same brand name for different drug formulations to prevent medication confusion and errors.

pharma.title: Eisai launches Alzheimer's drug Leqembi in India
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical firm Eisai has introduced its Alzheimer's disease drug, Leqembi, in the Indian market following CDSCO approval.

pharma.title: NPPA caps prices of 39 new medicines amid Parliamentary panel review
pharma.summary: While NPPA capped the prices of 39 new drugs, a Parliamentary panel highlighted that around 82% of medicines in India remain outside direct price control and urged a framework review.

national.title: India celebrates National Panchayati Raj Day
national.summary: National Panchayati Raj Day was celebrated across India to recognize and strengthen local self-governance institutes in rural areas.

national.title: PM Modi becomes longest-serving elected head of government in India
national.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi achieved a historic milestone by becoming the longest-serving elected head of government in India.

national.title: Maharashtra announces AI Policy 2026
national.summary: The Maharashtra government unveiled its AI Policy 2026 aimed at bolstering industrial growth, public service delivery, and state governance through artificial intelligence.

international.title: US-Canada trade talks collapse into tariff disputes
international.summary: Bilateral trade negotiations between the US and Canada devolved following disagreements over trade benefits and tariff terms.

international.title: BRICS Foreign Ministers exchange views on global issues
international.summary: Foreign Ministers of BRICS nations convened to hold discussions on key global political, economic, and regional developments.

international.title: Yomif Kejelcha breaks world half marathon record
international.summary: Distance runner Yomif Kejelcha set a new world half marathon record by finishing in 56 minutes and 51 seconds in Buenos Aires.

economy.title: RBI projects GDP growth at 6.9% while keeping repo rate unchanged
economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India maintained the benchmark repo rate at 5.25% and projected real GDP growth for the current fiscal year at 6.9%.

economy.title: India's Manufacturing PMI hits 5-year low
economy.summary: India's Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to a 5-year low, signaling a slowdown in industrial activity and output growth.

economy.title: Report outlines 20 key reforms for $20 Trillion economy by 2036
economy.summary: A economic report recommended implementing 20 critical structural reforms to propel India into a $20 trillion economy by the year 2036.

science.title: India and France review bilateral science, technology, and space cooperation
science.summary: India and France reviewed their joint initiatives to further expand bilateral ties in scientific research, technology development, and space exploration.

science.title: India reaffirms commitment to cervical cancer elimination
science.summary: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda reiterated India's commitment to eliminating cervical cancer through preventive healthcare measures and research.

science.title: Health ministry issues advisory following Delhi H1N1 spike
science.summary: With over 1,700 reported Swine Flu (H1N1) cases in Delhi, the Health Ministry listed key symptoms and urged public precautions.

environment.title: State of India's Environment 2026 Report released
environment.summary: The State of India's Environment 2026 report highlighted critical issues including mounting climate risks, human-wildlife conflicts, and gaps in pollution monitoring.

environment.title: BRICS officials meet in New Delhi on climate and sustainability
environment.summary: Senior officials from BRICS nations gathered in New Delhi to deliberate on joint environmental priorities, climate action, and sustainable development.

sports.title: First Khelo India Tribal Games begin in Chhattisgarh
sports.summary: The inaugural edition of the Khelo India Tribal Games commenced in Chhattisgarh to nurture sporting talent among tribal youth.

sports.title: SAI and MyBharat launch nationwide engagement initiatives
sports.summary: The Sports Authority of India partnered with MyBharat to launch nationwide youth engagement programs ahead of the upcoming Commonwealth Games.

awards_honours.title: PM Modi awarded FAO's highest honour - Agricola Medal
awards_honours.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with the Agricola Medal, the highest honour of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), which he dedicated to Indian farmers.

awards_honours.title: President Murmu to confer National Teachers Awards 2026
awards_honours.summary: President Droupadi Murmu will present the National Teachers Awards 2026 to 48 distinguished educators on Teachers' Day.

defence.title: India and Japan sign maritime security cooperation pact
defence.summary: India and Japan signed a bilateral agreement to enhance maritime security collaboration and deepen overall defence partnership.

defence.title: Defence Minister addresses National Security Summit 2.0
defence.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the National Security Summit 2.0 in New Delhi, emphasizing strategic readiness and border security.

schemes_appointments.title: Government launches PM RAHAT Scheme for road accident victims
schemes_appointments.summary: The Union Government introduced the PM RAHAT Scheme to provide cashless medical treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh for victims of road accidents.

schemes_appointments.title: Government introduces ₹497-crore RELIEF scheme for exporters
schemes_appointments.summary: A ₹497-crore RELIEF scheme was launched to support Indian exporters affected by trade disruptions stemming from the Middle East conflict.

schemes_appointments.title: Ashok Kumar Lahiri appointed Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog
schemes_appointments.summary: Economist Ashok Kumar Lahiri has been appointed as the new Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog.

schemes_appointments.title: UP Government launches MYUVA scheme
schemes_appointments.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government launched the MYUVA scheme to promote self-employment and empower young entrepreneurs across the state.

important_days.title: International Youth Day - 12 August
important_days.summary: International Youth Day is observed globally on August 12 to bring youth issues to the attention of the international community.

important_days.title: International Day of Yoga - 21 June
important_days.summary: Recognized by the United Nations, the International Day of Yoga is celebrated every year on June 21 to promote health and holistic well-being.

mcqs.q: Which scheme was recently launched by the central government to provide cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh for road accident victims?
mcqs.explanation: The central government launched the PM RAHAT Scheme offering cashless medical treatment up to ₹1,50,000 for road accident victims.

mcqs.q: What is the projected real GDP growth rate for India in the current fiscal year as per the RBI's Monetary Policy update?
mcqs.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% and projected India's real GDP growth at 6.9% for the current fiscal year.

mcqs.q: Which prestigious award from the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) was conferred upon Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
mcqs.explanation: PM Narendra Modi received the Agricola Medal, which is the highest honour bestowed by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
mcqs.explanation: Ashok Kumar Lahiri was recently appointed as the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog.

mcqs.q: The first edition of the Khelo India Tribal Games was hosted by which Indian state?
mcqs.explanation: The first Khelo India Tribal Games commenced in the state of Chhattisgarh to promote sports talent among tribal youth.
